scripts.prebuild: npm run clean && npm run version:sync
scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:react
scripts.version:bump:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run version:sync
scripts.version:bump:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run version:sync
scripts.version:bump:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run version:sync
